s1.desc: a snowy village in front of a round igloo house with a wooden door

s2.desc: a dining nook drawn on a plain pale grey background

spans.notes: Pax bent under the raised hood of a red snow car; a 12-frame hold before the camera starts to move
slow zoom in (background scale 1.04 from f12 to f41) while Pax straightens up and wipes his brow
sideways slide transition from the car to Polly; f46 is the first clean frame (f47 identical)

spans.view: with round windows on the igloo behind her and snow on the ground

beats.text: Polly stands holding an open red toolbox in both flippers and stares ahead
Polly lets the toolbox drop onto the snow and screws and bolts spill out around it
Polly stares ahead with rosy cheeks, her flippers hanging loose at her sides
Polly presses her flippers to her cheeks with her eyes closed and a dreamy open-beaked smile as a small heart rises above her head

spans.notes: background checked static with feature matching (scale 1.000, shift 0 from f46 to f79)

Pax driving with one flipper (car interior locked, town scrolls past the windows). A keychain with two little Polly figures and a name tag hangs from the steering column, and a Polly plush sits in the cup holder
Polly in the passenger seat watching, hearts; a little Pax figure sits on the dashboard phone mount and the phone screen shows a photo of the two leads
20 frames: Pax at the table drinking from a glass with his eyes closed, sparkles

spans.view: with the edge of a round cream table in front of her and a wooden chair behind

beats.text: Polly leans her face on her flippers and gazes ahead with a dreamy open-beaked smile as hearts float up above her
Polly squeezes her eyes shut happily, then looks out with heavy-lidded, lovestruck eyes
Polly gazes ahead with wide shining eyes and a soft smile while more hearts drift up over her head

spans.view: with a round cream table on a pale turquoise pedestal between them and two wooden chairs

beats.text: Pax sputters and coughs with his eyes squeezed shut beside his glass of water while Polly rests her face on her flippers and gazes at him under floating hearts
Pax jerks upright with wide eyes and lifts both flippers while Polly keeps gazing at him
